# The Mekong Order

> A forming social circle in Bangkok and the Mekong region for anthropologists, economists, adventurers and photographers.

- [Home and invitation information](https://mekongorder.org/)
- [Membership introductions](https://mekongorder.org/#membership)

The proposed format is small informal dinners, field stories and occasional member-proposed journeys. No first gathering date, established membership, bookable trip, partnership or affiliation is claimed. Introductions are requests, not membership acceptance. Contact: info@mekongorder.org.
